mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 49 degrees and clear near the Verona Area High School, with a waning crescent moon visible in the early morning sky.

The Verona Plan Commission meets this Wednesday to discuss several items including a final plat for Ardent Glen and various certified survey maps. Additionally, residents can check with the Building Inspection Department for the latest on permit regulations and site plan requirements.

There is plenty to do with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters at Lake Lou-ee both taking place today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can enjoy the downtown farmer's market or join trivia night at The Bogey Factory.
In police news, on October 3, officers arrested a 19-year-old Verona man who was found driving with expired registration and in possession of a stolen firearm.
Today's flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by once they open.
